hook: You won't believe 24 explorers spent 2 weeks mapping Canada's deepest cave near Fernie.

sections.voiceover: You won't believe 24 explorers spent 2 weeks mapping Canada's deepest cave near Fernie.
b_roll: Mountain terrain north of Fernie British Columbia

sections.voiceover: In November 2026, explorers mapped the Bisaro Anima system. Grantee Katie Graham received support from the Royal Canadian Geographical Society. How deep did 24 explorers reach beneath Fernie?
b_roll: Cavers entering Bisaro Anima cave system
Royal Canadian Geographical Society expedition emblem

sections.voiceover: However, 24 explorers didn't stop mapping the Bisaro Anima system for 2 full weeks.
b_roll: Underground cave passages and mapping gear

sections.voiceover: Featured in the documentary Subterranean, Katie Graham runs her caving apparel company Minus 90.
b_roll: Cave depth chart of Bisaro Anima system
Documentary footage shot of Subterranean expedition

sections.voiceover: These 24 explorers mapped Bisaro Anima near Fernie, establishing Canada's deepest and largest cave system.
b_roll: Wide view of mountains above Bisaro Anima cave
